Experiment_Info.query: Find the sink in the bathroom

Step_1.description: The robot is in a room with a blue wooden ceiling and floor, a large window with white curtains, and a dark purple sofa. A closed blue door is visible on the left. This appears to be a living room, not a bathroom.

Step_2.description: The robot is in a kitchen area, with a refrigerator, stove, and range hood visible. A closed blue double door is on the right side of the view. No open door is visible.

Step_3.description: The robot is in a kitchen area, facing a sink, dishwasher, and dining table. No doors are visible. Continuing to rotate left to search for a door.

Step_4.description: An open doorway is visible on the left, revealing a checkered floor in the room beyond. A kitchen counter with a backsplash is on the right.

Step_5.description: An open doorway is visible on the left, revealing a checkered floor beyond. The current room has a counter with patterned tiles, suggesting a kitchen area. Moving forward to get a clearer view of the room beyond the door.

Step_6.description: An open doorway is visible on the left, leading to a room with a black and white checkered floor. A closed white cabinet is in the center, and a counter with a patterned backsplash is on the right. The room beyond the door is identified as 'living room & kitchen', which is connected to the goal room 'bathroom'.

Step_7.description: The robot is facing a wall with a closed white cabinet. An open doorway is visible on the left, leading to a room with a checkered floor. A counter is on the right. The door is visible on the left and is not yet close or centered, so the robot moves forward to approach it.

Step_8.description: The robot is facing a closed white double door in the center. To the left, there is an open doorway leading to another room with a black and white checkered floor. The current room has blue wooden flooring and grey walls, with a blue ceiling. A counter is visible on the right. The open doorway is off-center to the left and not yet close, so the robot moves forward.

Step_9.description: The robot is facing a centered, closed door that appears close, with its top slightly cropped. Despite being closed, the robot is aligned and close enough to attempt passage, so it will move forward.

Step_10.description: A closed white double door is centered in front of the robot. The door is not open, so the robot cannot proceed through it and needs to re-evaluate its approach.

Step_11.description: The robot is facing a centered, closed white two-panel door with circular handles, against a grey wall. It appears close, filling most of the frame.

Step_12.description: The robot is facing two closed white doors with circular knobs, centered in the view. Since the door is closed, the robot cannot proceed through it and needs to re-evaluate its orientation.

Step_13.description: The robot is facing a closed white double door or cabinet with two round knobs, occupying the center of the view. A grey wall is visible on the left. The door appears centered and close.

Step_14.description: The robot is facing a closed white door with two round handles, centered in the view. The door is not open.

Step_15.description: The robot is facing a closed white door with a doorknob visible slightly to the right of the center. The door fills most of the camera view, indicating the robot is close. Following the policy note, the robot will proceed forward as it is close and off-center.

Step_16.description: The robot sees a light-colored wall with a white, faceted doorknob on the right side of the frame. The doorknob is not centered, indicating the need to rotate right to align with the door.

Step_17.description: The robot is facing a closed white door with a centered doorknob. The door appears relatively close, but it is not an open passage, so the robot needs to move closer.

Step_18.description: The robot is very close to a large, octagonal door that fills most of the view. The door is slightly to the right, with its top and bottom edges cropped, indicating proximity. A slight right rotation is needed to center it.
